text:
rohan_oncall: Handoff for overnight shift. Quick bullets — current incidents and what I did / blockers / next: 

rohan_oncall: 1) eu-west1 embed-evict spike — started ~01:10 UTC. Autoscaler thrashing + cache churn. Mitigation: limited burst scaling, disabled noncritical batch jobs, increased kvcache eviction_threshold to 0.78. Observed lower eviction rate but still noisy.

liya_eng: Noted. I pushed a small change to kvcache tuning flag in staging, will promote if stable. Will follow metrics for 30m. @michael_ops did you see any infra faults around 01:05?

michael_ops: saw binding errors on 3 nodes -> docker image oom restarts on gpu-nodes-07. Force-restarted agent on those nodes, node recovered. No separate networking alert.

rohan_oncall: good catch. I drained one overloaded pool and routed traffic to standby pool in eu-west1. Traffic QPS back to normalish (~95% of baseline).

taylor_dev: 2) regen-timeout on /v2/regen-large for some customers. Root cause seems to be very long-context requests hitting the async queue and exceeding per-request timeout. I raised timeout from 45s -> 90s in a canary for 2 replicas.

liya_eng: can we also add a soft-fail that returns partial regen with a warning instead of hard 500? That would keep UX better while we tune batching.

taylor_dev: yes, planning to add fallback path: if KV cache miss + seq_len > 8192 -> run truncated regen path. Will open PR now: <https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/4821>

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary/regen-timeout-fix -> staging at 3587654350 by taylor_dev :rocket:

michael_ops: for evictions, I'm keeping an eye on disk pressure + ephemeral storage on the affected hosts. I'll clear temp caches nightly for now and alert if any host goes >85% disk.

rohan_oncall: Blockers: none critical right now. Still want followups:
- liya_eng to confirm kvcache tuning safe to prod promote (watch 30-60m)
- taylor_dev finish PR for truncation fallback and monitor canary latency
- michael_ops keep node health checks and restart logic on standby nodes.

liya_eng: Starting the validation run. If stabilizes for 45m I'll request prod promote.

taylor_dev: canary in staging looks OK, latency p50 up ~120ms, p95 down from 12s->9s for truncated loads. Opening canary monitor dashboard (link: https://dash.internal/d/regen/canary)

michael_ops: created alert rule 'eu-west1-kv-evict-rate' with 10m window, threshold 0.6. If fires, page oncall.

rohan_oncall: Operational notes: leave runbook page updated (https://wiki.internal/ops/kv-evict) — I added steps 3-5. If anything pages, escalate to oncall-2.

liya_eng: tagging @taylor_dev for followup PR reviews later.

taylor_dev: ack, will ping reviewers.

rohan_oncall: Closing handoff, ETA check-in in 45m. If anything emerges call the bridge. :phone:

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window eu-west1 03:00-03:30 UTC. Non-critical batch jobs will be paused automatically.

michael_ops: noted, I'll avoid node evictions during that window unless critical.

rohan_oncall: last: leaving short checklist for night: 
- watch evict rate + disk
- monitor regen canary dashboard
- be ready to rollback canary to prior image (image: redwood/regen:v2.9.1)

liya_eng: thanks, taking over until 04:00 UTC.

rohan_oncall: Thanks all, handing off.
